source: the generator eval/scorecard/fixtures/pptx_charts.py and its data module chart_data.py, cross-checked with unzip -p ppt/slides/slide*.xml and ppt/charts/chart*.xml
notes: Four slides: title slide (level 0 title, one subtitle paragraph), then three title-only slides (level 1) each holding one chart: a two-series clustered column chart titled 'Revenue by region' with axis titles Region and kUSD, a pie chart titled 'Share by segment', and a line chart with no chart title but axis titles Month and Degrees C.

Each chart is expected as one CHART picture under its slide group after the slide title, with its data bound as a table (label row, then one row per category) and, when the chart has a title, a caption carrying it.
Chart tables: the corner cell is the category axis title when the chart states one (Region, Month); the pie has none and its corner is not asserted. Series labels head the value columns.
Anchors: the subtitle, the two chart captions and the last slide title; slide titles double as group names, so the figure anchors name the slide group.
